about: URL vectors for validate_url(url, kind) -> host | reason. A heimdall-authored stand-in written from hmdapp's docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-03-remote-cc-login.md section 3.2 until the app's wave-0 docs/samples/login/url-vectors.json lands (vendor that file over this one, re-pin the checksum in test/companion-cc-login-vectors.test.sh, and reconcile any differing reason string). Reason mapping used here: rule 1 (scheme, userinfo, port, host form) -> bad-url; rule 2 (the host/path pair is not an allowlist row) -> host-not-allowed; rules 3, 4 and 5 (query, length, kind) -> bad-url. expect is the host on success: ok means validate_url returns the allowlist host the URL names. PKCE-shaped values are runs of one letter, never real ones.
